pulse_hypothesis.method: coherent comb search on detrended clipped spectral flux, 10–230s, search 83.5–86.5 BPM; slower pulse selected as a hypothesis

uncertainty.note: Prediction is not a detected beat. Flux windows smear onsets. No kick/snare/vocal isolation, bar numbering, full-song listening, browser decode alignment or audiovisual sync measurement is implied.
